snippet.title: Pad Quad | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Youtube
#AfilGames #PadQuad

🇧🇷🇵🇹
🦊 Velocidade, reflexo e ação arcade em cada fase!
Pad Quad é um platformer acelerado onde você controla mascotes pixelados inspirados nas raquetes da QUAD Sports. Corra por arenas futuristas cheias de inimigos, armadilhas e desafios de precisão enquanto tenta bater seu próprio tempo a cada rodada. ⚡

Disponível a partir de 20 de novembro para PlayStation e com 20% de desconto no Xbox e Microsoft Store! 🎮

🇺🇸🇬🇧
🦊 Speed, reflexes and pure arcade action every second!
Pad Quad is a fast-paced platformer where you control pixel mascots inspired by QUAD Sports rackets. Dash through futuristic arenas packed with traps, enemies and tight challenges built for fast reaction and nonstop momentum. ⚡

Available starting November 20 for PlayStation with 20% off on Xbox and Microsoft Store! 🎮


👇👇👇
🎮 PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016268
🎮 Xbox Series: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/pad-quad-xbox-series/9p3zx8wd027p
🎮 Xbox One: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/pad-quad-xbox-one/9nkxzfw9lbbb
💻 Microsoft Store (Windows): https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/pad-quad-windows/9p844g5tfglr
🎮 Nintendo Switch (EU): https://x.gd/EP41G
🎮 Nintendo Switch (US): https://x.gd/PmdXn
